name: MotionKit
message: 55 new editor templates (render bars, errors, drag & drop, effect search ...) + update checker.
how: Download the new version from your Gumroad library, close After Effects / Premiere Pro, run the installer (or replace the plugin folder) and restart the app. Your settings and license stay.

changes.text: 28 editor timeline templates: render bar green / red, render queue, trim in / out, split layer, drag file to timeline, pre-compose, pick whip, markers, time remap, waveform, expression error, missing footage and more

27 editor UI templates: error + warning dialogs, render complete, render progress, out of memory, missing fonts, drag & drop import, effect search typing, effect controls, color picker, export settings, undo history and more
Update checker: MotionKit tells you when a new version is out (header button + Settings > About > Updates)
243 money templates in Simple, Loops, Explosions, Paper Cut, Hand Drawn, Infographics, Timeline and UI Animation
Grid + Split: presets drawer with thumbnail size, settings in tabs
Corner / box reveal grid animations and 21 Reveal presets
40 editor timeline templates (colorist, mobile editor, keyframes, graph editor)
Theme accent colors are perfect circles
